Unresolved failure path handling in production Voice Bot integration creates risk of customer-facing incidents, poor member experience, and potential escalation if failures are not gracefully handled.
predictedRisks.currentProjectPhase: Execution - Post-MVP Enhancement and Production Support
predictedRisks.rootCause: Genesys integration failure path logic is incomplete or incorrect, requiring coordination with the Genesys team for resolution. The issue has persisted across multiple sprints without closure, suggesting either technical complexity, dependency on Genesys team availability, or insufficient prioritization.
triggerConditions: Genesys failure path issues remain unresolved beyond September 15, 2026
Production incidents occur due to unhandled Genesys failures
Customer-facing Voice Bot errors increase in frequency
Escalation from Premera operations or customer service teams

potentialImpact.customer: Poor member experience if Voice Bot failures are not gracefully handled; potential call abandonment or frustration
potentialImpact.operational: Production incidents require immediate response and consume capacity allocated for planned work
potentialImpact.reputation: Customer-facing failures may damage confidence in AI-enabled capabilities and transformation program

predictedRisks.reasoning: WSR explicitly states 'Genesys failure path issues are still being worked upon. Team is working with Genesys team to resolve this' and lists it as an ongoing challenge. The issue appears in both 'This Week' and 'Challenges' sections, indicating persistence across sprint cycles. With Voice Bot in production and serving customer interactions, unresolved failure path handling creates risk of customer-facing incidents that could damage confidence in the AI transformation program and trigger operational escalations.
monitoringIndicators: Genesys failure path issue resolution status and target date
Production incident frequency related to Voice Bot Genesys integration
Customer experience metrics for Voice Bot interactions

actions: Prioritize Genesys failure path resolution with target completion date of September 15, 2026; coordinate with Genesys team to accelerate fix delivery
Implement graceful failure handling and error messaging for Voice Bot Genesys integration to prevent customer-facing incidents while permanent fix is developed

recommendations.Integration Quality: Conduct end-to-end integration testing for Genesys failure scenarios before production deployment to validate failure path handling
recommendations.Production Monitoring: Implement production monitoring for Voice Bot Genesys integration failures; establish alerting thresholds to enable proactive incident response
recommendations.Customer Experience: Track customer experience metrics for Voice Bot interactions to detect degradation early and prevent escalations from operations teams
